QUOTE: Tiers 3 and 4 accumulate and survive every stated tier. A stated `entry_patterns` list cannot remove the built-in `main` entry, because the facts layer always stays in the resolved set. Tier 5 is the only layer a stated value displaces.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says tiers 3 and 4 both accumulate and survive, but it never says they combine identically, that the distinction is deliberately inert, or that the line that matters is fact versus guess.
